{{Infobox character|name=Lyra Ravenshade|house=[[House Ravenshade]]|role=Heir; the house's envoy|age=~22|kin=[[Sabra Ravenshade]] (mother)}}
'''Lyra Ravenshade''' is the heir of [[House Ravenshade]], sent as the house's envoy into the courts of the realm. She has done exactly what the craft demands — grown close to the principals she was sent to read. The craft does not say what to do when the closeness becomes real.
